newsitem.title: FRANCE: Framatome to absorb GEC-Alsthom -- paper.
newsitem.headline: Framatome to absorb GEC-Alsthom -- paper.

text.p: French nuclear engineering company Framatome, majority-owned by state companies and partly-owned by Alcatel Alsthom, would absorb the GEC-Alsthom joint venture as part of a planned merger, a newspaper said.

The Les Echos newspaper said talks between Alcatel, its British partner GEC Plc and the French authorities about a possible merger were focusing on the smaller group absorbing the big Anglo-French joint-venture.
GEC would take a stake "as close as possible" to 50 percent while the nuclear activities would be put in a special subsidiary in which the French state would have a golden share.
